judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: The element is the second hero slide link, aria-label "ARZ - SAPATOS E BOLSAS - DESK", leading to /c/tudo60 ("SAPATOS 60% E BOLSAS 50%"). The name has CMS noise (ARZ, DESK), but its meaningful words, shoes and bags, are the destination's subject; what it leaves out is the discount. So "does not match" overstates it. No heading supplies context: the nearest preceding one is the empty-cart drawer's h3. My lean is that the topic is conveyed well enough to decide whether to follow the link, but competent auditors could reasonably hold that a CMS code naming only the product categories does not convey the purpose of a sale page. Hence uncertain. The image's alt problem is a 1.1.1 matter (bffe10851422). The live server data still has this slide with an empty imageAltText.
